Topic: AI design and interfaces

Posted by Santiago (@svpino) on 2026-10-15

This is an open-source framework that lets you add AI-generated interfaces to your apps.

For example, you can have a travel assistant agent respond with a hotel card, a map, and an interactive UI that compares plane tickets instead of a wall of text.

For 30 years, technology has moved in one direction: turning information into intuitive interfaces

Somehow, the smartest software we’ve ever built took us back to a textbox

We’ve spent the last 2 years at @openuidev trying to fix that. 6 months ago we open-sourced it: 10K+
